scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: I'm inquiring about the status of my housing loan application that I submitted recently. Could you please tell me if it's still pending or if there's been a decision made on it?
dialogue.agent: According to our records, the action taken on your housing loan application was that the loan was purchased. This indicates that your loan application was approved and the loan was subsequently sold to another institution, in this case, Freddie Mac. Is there anything specific you'd like to know about your loan terms or details?

dialogue.user: So my loan application was approved, and the loan was sold to Freddie Mac. That's good to know. Can you please tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs of the loan are? I'd like to understand the details of my loan.
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.125% and the total loan costs are $3,316.75. These costs are associated with your loan and are part of the terms of your agreement. If you have any further questions about these details or other aspects of your loan, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user: So my interest rate is 6.125% and the total loan costs are $3,316.75. That's helpful to know. Can you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And what about my debt-to-income ratio, what does that look like for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. Regarding your debt-to-income ratio, the record does not show a specific value for this field, so I cannot provide that information. If you have any other questions about your loan terms or details, I'll do my best to help.

dialogue.user: appreciate the information. So, just to recap, my loan was approved, sold to Freddie Mac, has an interest rate of 6.125%, and total loan costs of $3,316.75. There's no high-cost mortgage classification or negative amortization features. One more question: What type of loan product was I approved
dialogue.agent: Your loan product type is Conventional: First Lien. This indicates that your loan is a conventional loan, which is not insured or guaranteed by the government, and it's a first lien, meaning it's the primary loan secured by the property. I've provided all the information available in your loan record. If you have any further questions, feel free to ask, but I've covered all the details I have access to.

dialogue.user: Thank you for providing all the information. I think I have a clear understanding of my loan terms and details now. I appreciate your help and professionalism throughout this conversation. I'm satisfied with the interaction and the information you provided.<Satisfied> I felt satisfied with the interaction because the agent was competent, courteous, and provided clear and timely information about my loan application.
